levels.surface: عبيد الله بن عدي بن الخيار

notes: Miswar and Abd al-Rahman speak to Ubayd Allah inside the story, so they are scene figures, not links (rule 6); Ubayd Allah narrates the story in the first person («قلت») and is the last link
«قال معمر أراه قال» is a remark about wording, left out
«أبي» is a bare relation; the Ahmad-b.-Shabib chain has correspondences in other works that are not used here
